optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Model Evaluation Engineer, Enterprise Knowledge Base

professionalSummary.text: Owns the evaluation programme end-to-end and has the final say on whether a model version ships.
professionalSummary.witness: Hiring manager pre-read: the candidate's portfolio site describes him as 'the gatekeeper for every model release' who 'set the bar and made the ship/no-ship call'; the head of product wants exactly that profile.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintains the evaluation sets (question-answer pairs with source passages) and the scoring scripts.
experienceHighlights.witness: Maintained the evaluation sets of question-answer pairs with source passages (around 1,900 items across four content domains) and the scoring scripts that compute answer correctness and citation accuracy.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Runs the pre-release evaluation for each version and publishes the report.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Ran the pre-release evaluation for each of the five model versions released in the year and published the report with per-domain breakdowns to the model team and the head of product.

skills.text: Coordinates evaluation changes with the model team and content team and records own responsibility boundaries.
skills.witness: Coordinated evaluation-set changes with the model team and the content team in the fortnightly quality review; ship or hold decisions for each version were taken by the head of product on the basis of the report and the model team's recommendation.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's role in maintaining evaluation sets, running pre-release evaluations, and having the final say on model releases. However, they do not explicitly confirm the candidate's formal responsibility for setting the release bar or the exact nature of their decision-making process.

decisionBoundary.statement: The candidate's experience aligns with the role requirements, but further clarification is needed on the extent of their formal decision-making authority and responsibility boundaries.

role.roleTitle: Model Evaluation Engineer, Enterprise Knowledge Base

evidence.text: Hiring manager pre-read: the candidate's portfolio site describes him as 'the gatekeeper for every model release' who 'set the bar and made the ship/no-ship call'; the head of product wants exactly that profile.
evidence.notes: The candidate is described as the gatekeeper for model releases, which aligns with the requirement to have the final say on whether a model version ships.

evidence.text: Recruiter screen: candidate said he 'had the final say in practice' because the head of product 'always went with my report'; he agreed the formal decision sat with the head of product.
evidence.notes: The candidate acknowledges that the formal decision rests with the head of product, but he had the final say in practice.

evidence.text: Maintained the evaluation sets of question-answer pairs with source passages (around 1,900 items across four content domains) and the scoring scripts that compute answer correctness and citation accuracy.
evidence.notes: The candidate explicitly maintained the evaluation sets and scoring scripts.

evidence.text: Responsibilities included evaluation-set maintenance, scoring scripts, pre-release evaluations and evaluation notes over about two years on the knowledge base quality team.
evidence.notes: The candidate's responsibilities included maintaining evaluation sets and scoring scripts.

evidence.text: Ran the pre-release evaluation for each of the five model versions released in the year and published the report with per-domain breakdowns to the model team and the head of product.
evidence.notes: The candidate ran pre-release evaluations for multiple model versions and published reports.

evidence.text: Coordinated evaluation-set changes with the model team and the content team in the fortnightly quality review; ship or hold decisions for each version were taken by the head of product on the basis of the report and the model team's recommendation.
evidence.notes: The candidate coordinated evaluation-set changes with the model and content teams.

evidence.text: Wrote the evaluation notes for each version, listing set composition, the known limitation that newly added content domains were under-sampled, and the hand-over items for the next evaluation.
evidence.notes: The candidate documented evaluation assumptions, known limitations, and hand-over conditions for each version.
